modules.title: Module 1: How Crypto Markets Actually Work

lessons.title: What Is Crypto & Why Does Price Move?
lessons.objective: Understand basic market mechanics: buyers vs sellers and why price moves.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Every candle is the outcome of a fight between buyers and sellers — price shows who won.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Use a tug-of-war analogy and show a live BTC chart to demonstrate.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Observe a Bitcoin chart for 15 minutes and note up/down moves — no trades.

lessons.title: Reading a Candle Chart for the First Time
lessons.objective: Learn the components of a candlestick and the difference between green and red candles.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: A candle shows open, high, low and close for a timeframe — the body shows who won that period.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Pull up BTC on TradingView and point to individual candles while explaining.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Find 5 green and 5 red candles on a 1H chart and record their O/H/L/C.

lessons.title: Timeframes: Which One Should You Use?
lessons.objective: Understand the top-down approach and which timeframes to prioritize for ICC.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Daily shows the big picture; 1H is where ICC setups are found; 15m/5m fine-tune entries.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Demonstrate the same asset across Daily → 4H → 1H → 15m to show differences.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Describe the trend on Daily, 4H, 1H and 15m for BTC in one sentence each.

lessons.title: Support & Resistance: The Building Blocks
lessons.objective: Learn how to identify and draw key support and resistance zones correctly.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Support is a floor where buyers defend; resistance is a ceiling where sellers push back.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Draw zones (not lines) and be selective — prefer 2–3 clear levels per chart.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Draw 2–3 support/resistance zones on BTC 1H chart and share a screenshot.

lessons.title: Uptrends: Higher Highs & Higher Lows
lessons.objective: Identify uptrends via higher highs and higher lows and trade with the trend.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: An uptrend prints higher highs and higher lows — bias to buys only in an uptrend.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Mark HH/HL on a BTC chart and ask students to point to each structure.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Find an uptrend on a 1H chart and mark every HH and HL; share a screenshot.

lessons.title: Downtrends: Lower Lows & Lower Highs
lessons.objective: Recognize downtrends and focus on sell opportunities until structure changes.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Downtrend rule: lower lows and lower highs; trade with the bias and avoid buys.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Use historical downtrend examples (e.g., 2022 BTC) for clarity.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Find a downtrend, mark LL/LH and explain why it qualifies as a downtrend.

lessons.title: Consolidation: When to Walk Away
lessons.objective: Spot consolidation ranges and learn why ICC setups fail in chop.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Consolidation = sideways range; avoid trading until structure resolves.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Point out fake breakouts and explain why they lure beginners.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Find a consolidation range, screenshot, and mark the top/bottom of the range.

lessons.title: When Trends Switch: The Golden Nugget
lessons.objective: Detect early signs of trend switches and adjust trading narrative accordingly.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: A lower high in an uptrend or a higher low in a downtrend signals potential switch.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Show a real example where a structure break preceded a trend reversal.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Analyze three charts and report whether each is uptrend, downtrend, or consolidation.

lessons.title: What Is ICC? The 3-Phase Cycle Explained
lessons.objective: Introduce Indication, Correction, Continuation and why waiting matters.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: ICC = Indication, Correction, Continuation — wait for Continuation to enter.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Draw a simple sketch of I → C → C before showing real charts.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Watch Trades By Sci videos and bring one question to class.

lessons.title: Phase 1: Indication (The Signal)
lessons.objective: Define valid indication breaks and distinguish fakeouts.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: An Indication requires a clear candle close beyond a structural high/low — no wicks-only breaks.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Compare a valid break and a fakeout side-by-side for emphasis.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Find one valid Indication and one fakeout and explain the difference.

lessons.title: Phase 2: Correction (The Pullback)
lessons.objective: Understand why corrections occur and how to watch for invalidation of setups.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Corrections pull against the trend but should not break structure if the setup remains valid.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Show corrections of different depths and discuss how to judge them.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Screenshot a correction that did NOT break structure and explain why it held.

lessons.title: Phase 3: Continuation (Your Entry)
lessons.objective: Learn confirmation rules for Continuation and where to place stops.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Enter on the Continuation break — confirmation that buyers/sellers regained control.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Drop to 15m/5m to pick a precise entry candle during Continuation.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Find two Continuation entries on 1H setups and mark your entry and stop levels.

modules.title: Module 4: Entries, Stop Losses & Take Profits

lessons.title: Where Exactly Do You Enter the Trade?
lessons.objective: Follow a checklist before entry and use multi-timeframe confirmation.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Entry is the last step — confirm trend, Indication, Correction and Continuation.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Run through a live checklist on a chart so students internalize it.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Use the checklist on one ICC setup and document each decision before paper-trading.

lessons.title: Stop Loss Placement: Protecting Yourself
lessons.objective: Place stops where the trade is invalidated (beyond Correction extremes).

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Stops go beyond the Correction extreme — not where you’re merely comfortable losing.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Explain buffers and why moving stops wider ruins risk management.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Pick an entry and design an appropriate stop with a brief justification.

lessons.title: Take Profit: When to Get Out
lessons.objective: Choose targets by nearby support/resistance and use partial exits or trailing stops.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Target the next key level; consider partial exits and moving stops to break-even.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Discuss psychology of exits and demonstrate partial exit math.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Plan a take-profit strategy for your paper-trade and record the R:R.

lessons.title: Using Multiple Timeframes for Entries
lessons.objective: Use 4H→1H→15m/5m flow to tighten entries and improve risk-to-reward.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: 4H shapes the story, 1H shows the setup, 15m/5m gives the precise entry.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Live-demo a multi-timeframe entry to show stop size differences.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Identify a multi-timeframe entry and compute stop distance and position size.

lessons.title: Why Most Beginners Blow Their Accounts
lessons.objective: Understand common fatal mistakes and why risk management matters more than setups.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Most account blowups are caused by poor risk management, not strategy flaws.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Share real-world stories to emphasize the psychological component.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Audit your recent demo trades for risk sizing errors and note patterns.

lessons.title: The 1-2% Rule & Position Sizing
lessons.objective: Teach the 1-2% risk rule and how to calculate position size based on stop distance.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Risk no more than 1-2% per trade to survive losing streaks and preserve capital.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Work through example math with student account sizes.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Calculate position size for three hypothetical stops with your account size.

lessons.title: Risk-to-Reward: Only Take Good Deals
lessons.objective: Apply pre-trade R:R checks and enforce a minimum 1:2 requirement.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Only take trades with at least 1:2 risk-to-reward — it changes required winrate.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Show how R:R affects long-term expectancy with simple math.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Revisit your paper trades and compute the R:R for each; improve entries if needed.

lessons.title: Trading Psychology for Beginners
lessons.objective: Recognize fear, greed, FOMO and revenge trading and how to manage them.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Process over outcome — score yourself on process, not individual trade results.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Encourage journaling and share a short emotional self-checklist.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Start a trade journal and record emotions for 5 paper trades.

lessons.title: How to Build a Trading Routine
lessons.objective: Create a repeatable pre/during/post session routine to build consistency.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Consistency beats spikes of activity — routines create reproducible behavior.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Provide a sample daily checklist students can copy.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Draft a daily routine and follow it for one week; report back.

lessons.title: Putting It All Together: Your Trading Plan
lessons.objective: Write a personal trading plan covering asset choice, timeframe, risk and rules.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: A written plan is your rulebook — include assets, timeframes, stop rules, R:R and journal rules.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Ask students to share plans and give peer feedback for accountability.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Write and share your personal trading plan; paper trade 5 setups using it.

lessons.title: Course Wrap & Final Project
lessons.objective: Consolidate learning with a final project: written plan + 5 paper trades.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Complete the final project: a written plan and documented paper trades for review.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Offer a Q&A and peer review session one week after course end.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Submit final project: plan + 5 documented paper trades.

lessons.title: Bonus: Review & Next Steps
lessons.objective: Review key takeaways and plan the next steps for continued improvement.

reveals.title: SAY
reveals.content: Summarize the ICC checklist and personal next steps for continued progress.

reveals.title: TEACHER TIP
reveals.content: Provide resources for further study and recommend review cadence.

reveals.title: HOMEWORK
reveals.content: Create a 30-day improvement plan: daily routine, targets, and journaling cadence.
